description:
`proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/QuotientReduction.lean` and `RelativeExtension.lean` cite `crates/gf2-core/src/field/axiom_tests.rs:<line>` for the Rust tests their statements mirror. The cited lines pointed at closing braces and mid-function expressions before the comment sweep, and the sweep shifted them further.

## Background

A content match of the cited lines against the file at commit `1b1f1c748` shows the earlier drift. `@/inv/single-source-prose` applies: a line number is a volatile fact.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each citation names the Rust test or check function by symbol, without a line number.
- [hard] REQ-02: `(cd proofs && lake build)` passes.
title: Lean proof comments cite stale line numbers in axiom_tests.rs
